title: Support Ars and get a better reading experience in return
gist: Promotional Ars Technica piece pitching ArsPro ($25) and ArsPro++ ($50) subscriptions: ad-free, tracker-free reading, PDFs, full-text RSS, subscriber forums and layout options. Little investable signal.

insights.claim: Ars Technica offers ArsPro subscribers an ad-free, tracker-free experience, subscriber-only forums, four front page layouts, PDFs of every article and full-text RSS feeds.
insights.speaker: Eric Bangeman
insights.so_what: Example of a publisher shifting to reader-paid revenue.

insights.claim: Ars prices ArsPro at $25 and ArsPro++ at $50 and says each subscriber helps it rely less on advertising and more on readers.
insights.speaker: Eric Bangeman
insights.so_what: Signals publisher revenue mix shift from ads to subscriptions.
insights.quote: helps us rely less on advertising and more on the readers
